analyst_view.overall: The Seville derby: Sevilla (6th, 18 pts) host in-form Betis (4th, 26 pts) at the Pizjuán on Saturday evening; Betis have lost only one of the last eight derbies and play in Europe three days later. Dani Ceballos missed two training sessions this week with hamstring discomfort (tests reportedly ruled out an injury) and is still unconfirmed, Riquelme had pharyngitis but is not expected to miss out, Morante is recovering from a hip knock (in the numbers) and Cucho Hernández is back in partial group work, at best a bench option, while the numbers take him off. Antony is in line to play the derby at the Pizjuán for Betis. On Sevilla's side Carmona is out for the season (in the numbers); I found no fresh Sevilla team news beyond that. No referee had been named in the pages I read; the numbers already add a large derby boost to cards.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals and take about 10% of Betis' scoring off for Cucho Hernández and some for Morante. Cucho could come off the bench, which pulls up a little, but Ceballos, who set up both goals against Elche, is still unconfirmed, which pulls down. These cancel out, so I stay at 2.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.0 corners and already take some off Sevilla for their low recent count (19 in six games). Betis' wide play with Antony and Abde is part of their usual numbers, and nothing in the news changes either side's approach. I keep 9.0.

cards.text: The numbers say 7.0 cards, already including a large derby boost (about +39%) on top of both sides' card form. Derbies here are heated, but that is exactly what the boost counts, and no referee is named yet. I don't add more and stay at 7.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.4 shots and already add Betis' busy recent shooting (97 in six games) and Sevilla conceding plenty. Betis' internationals only returned midweek, and Ceballos' doubt may take a little out of their build-up, but neither is clear enough to move it. I stay at 27.4.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target and already add Betis' good recent accuracy. Ceballos' doubt and Cucho's limited fitness could take a little off Betis, but tests found no injury for Ceballos and Antony is available. I stay at 9.2.
